name: 07307 · Jersey City, NJ
findings: ZIP 07307 (Jersey City) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07307 (Jersey City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07307 (Jersey City) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
